method: Continuous source-art crayon arm/head deformation; original face marks yaw within the head before reflection. Small drawn cyan doodle effects and spatial erasure are authored additions. No hidden anatomy or replacement face drawn.

actions.idle: Soft line shimmer and a small hand wave with planted feet.
actions.attack: Hand withdraws, sweeps left through a short crayon arc, then erases the arc and returns.
actions.hurt: Head and hand flinch right and recover.
actions.defeat: The crayon figure erases progressively from the feet upward, ending fully transparent.
actions.cast: A slower hand gesture draws one rounded house outline to the left, pauses and erases it.

orientation.method: Reflected oversized hand gestures left. Original face-bearing marks yaw toward left within the head; recoil goes right and ready stance returns left. No text or held handed prop.
